Original 1990s shonen battle-anime arcade interface illustration for a playful neighborhood parent-hero tournament. Bold brush ink, hard cel shadows, hand-painted energy clouds, deep midnight blue and black, vivid gold, electric cyan and hot magenta. Strong negative space for readable game controls. All characters and locations are invented; no real faces, recognizable real venues, brand marks or copied franchise imagery.
An original circular tournament badge made from three linked rectangular workflow nodes and an electric lightning bolt, yellow white cyan and magenta inked emblem, no text. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.
Create the requested original game art. Follow the layout and reference identity precisely.

CLOUD ONLY. This graph contains 1 paid image-generation node(s). Running those nodes consumes Comfy credits. Save nodes only process local files. No generation is triggered by creating or building these files.

All references are invented from text in this graph. No photographs or files from previous sessions are loaded.

Outputs: ComfyUI/output/hackathon/. Import with npm run import:assets -- --from <output-folder>, then npm run build. Inspect pose sheets and anchors before release. Do not put credentials in this workflow.
